youtube.script: Three AI signals worth watching this Friday: first, Thinking Machines released Inkling as an open-weights multimodal model, and it’s available on Tinker today. Second, GitHub’s AI security detections are now in public preview on pull requests, but they’re informational, not merge-blocking. Third, Reuters reported a more than $1 billion compute deal for Reflection, which is a reminder that AI systems still run on expensive infrastructure. The business question is not which demo looks best — it’s which system you can actually operate.
